text:
**Changes and why**

The design fails only at ss / −40 °C / 1.62 V, where f_mid is 451 MHz. That is about 4% below the 470 MHz target, so it needs a little more speed with some margin. Power has plenty of room: 310 µW at tt against a 750 µW limit.

1. **Lower R0 from 5 kΩ to 4.2 kΩ.** The V-to-I converter's current is set by roughly (Vctrl − Vth)/R0, so this raises the reference current by about 19%. The mirrors copy that increase into the starved stages, and frequency of a current-starved ring scales roughly with the starving current. Expected gain is about +15–19%, giving about 520 MHz at ss/cold/low VDD. I estimate ff/hot/1.98 V power at about 600 µW, under 750 µW, but only simulation will confirm that.
2. **Shrink the first output-buffer inverter (MPB1/MNB1) from 3 µm / 1.5 µm to 1.5 µm / 0.75 µm.** Its gate loads node x3, so a smaller inverter cuts that stage's extra capacitance and makes the three ring stages better balanced. This adds a few percent of frequency at no power cost. The second buffer stage is kept, so the output still swings rail to rail.

```spice
.subckt dut vctrl vout vdd vss
* ---- V-to-I bias ----
MN0  pb  vctrl ns  vss nfet W=4  L=0.5
R0   ns  vss  4.2k
R1   pb  vss  80k
MP0  pb  pb   vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=0.3
MP1  nb  pb   vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=0.3
MN1  nb  nb   vss vss nfet W=4  L=0.3
* ---- stage 1 (in x3 -> out x1) ----
MPS1 p1  pb   vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=0.3
MP1i x1  x3   p1  vdd pfet W=3  L=0.25
MN1i x1  x3   n1  vss nfet W=1.5 L=0.25
MNS1 n1  nb   vss vss nfet W=4  L=0.3
* ---- stage 2 (in x1 -> out x2) ----
MPS2 p2  pb   vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=0.3
MP2i x2  x1   p2  vdd pfet W=3  L=0.25
MN2i x2  x1   n2  vss nfet W=1.5 L=0.25
MNS2 n2  nb   vss vss nfet W=4  L=0.3
* ---- stage 3 (in x2 -> out x3) ----
MPS3 p3  pb   vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=0.3
MP3i x3  x2   p3  vdd pfet W=3  L=0.25
MN3i x3  x2   n3  vss nfet W=1.5 L=0.25
MNS3 n3  nb   vss vss nfet W=4  L=0.3
* ---- output buffer ----
MPB1 b1  x3   vdd vdd pfet W=1.5  L=0.15
MNB1 b1  x3   vss vss nfet W=0.75 L=0.15
MPB2 vout b1  vdd vdd pfet W=6  L=0.15
MNB2 vout b1  vss vss nfet W=3  L=0.15
.ends
```
